sections.appearance: Himari has lavender white eyes. Her hair is also lavender white, waist length, tied into straight pigtails with navy ribbons with golden accents. She also wears a similar styled hairband, and a white flower hair ornament close to her left temple. She has elven ears, and pale skin. Halo ==== Himari's halo is comprised of six arrowhead-shaped pieces arranged in a hexagonal pattern with six glowing white petals in between each piece. Uniform ==== Himari wears a white robe, a single-breasted vest on top, which is also white, the button is gold, the folds are navy blue, and the sleeves, and collar are cream. She is wearing a black turtleneck underneath. She has a cream blanket wrapped around her legs, her robe, and black leggings underneath. She wears white socks, and navy blue shoes with black soles. She wears a pair of navy blue smart gloves, with golden wiring on the back of each hand. She mounts a white wheelchair with navy front wheels, rear wheel rims, inner side panels, footrest, and push handle. It has no backrest. The Millennium logo can be seen on the side panel, rear wheels, and the back arch, connecting the wheels by the axles. The arch is navy with white edges, with a set of golden buttons located on the right side panel. Winter: She was wearing a yellow puffer jacket with some black sections and a white fur hood. Yellow boots with black bows, black soles, and fur at the toes. cream blanket wrapped Firearm ==== She uses a two-tone black and white Smith & Wesson Model

sections.personality: As someone unanimously deserving of her title as a genius, Himari is very intelligent. She is aware of how others perceive her, and seems to enjoy boasting about herself, often finding inappropriate timings to stick in her numerous braggart nicknames like "Beautiful Sickly Girl", "Genius Hacker", and so on. She's also honest, perhaps a bit too honest, in expressing her thoughts.
